extended_radius.note: Destination events worth a longer drive. Also applies to large model railroad shows.

interests: BMW motorcycles: BMW MOA / local BMW riders club meetups, rallies, dealer events, group rides, motorcycle shows
Volkswagen / VAG cars: VW, Audi, Porsche, Seat, Skoda enthusiast meets, club gatherings, car shows, cars & coffee and cruise-ins focused on VW/VAG
historic reenactment: Revolutionary War, Civil War, colonial and living-history events at historic sites and battlefields
air shows: military and civilian air shows, fly-ins, warbird and aviation heritage days
balloon festivals: hot air balloon festivals, glows and mass ascensions
railroads: heritage and excursion trains, railroad museums, rail festivals and railfan days
camping: campouts, outdoor skills workshops, state park programs
RV: RV shows, rallies, RV club gatherings and expos
rock climbing: climbing gym events, comps, clinics, outdoor crag meetups and cleanups
modeling: scale model shows and contests (IPMS), model railroad shows, RC model events
firearms: gun shows, shooting competitions and matches, range days, safety and carry courses
